summary: Phase 1 tickets/support system tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (24 tests) covering config, dynamic categories, create+validation+cooldown+429, GET persistence, message + internal-note, staff take/update priority/status, audit-log, staff-list boxes+counts+search, 404 and unauth 401 — all 24 passed. Frontend /soporte flow verified with the demo (admin) user: staff toggle visible, category picker with all 7 categories, dynamic forms (general, report_player, appeal->sanction_type, patreon->discord_user), ticket creation opening chat, WebSocket connect, staff panel with all 7 boxes+counts, ticket detail view showing chat bubbles (STAFF/tú), internal-note (amber), audit-log with 5 chronological events, priority/status selectors persist, copy-steamid present, no horizontal overflow, no console errors.
action_items: (Nice-to-have UX) In the 'new ticket' flow, clicking 'Nuevo ticket' again while already in new-mode with a selected category does NOT reset the picker — the user must click 'Cambiar categoría' to switch. Consider having 'Nuevo ticket' always reset selected category to null so users can switch categories in one click.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/tickets.py TicketHub is a process-local in-memory set. In a multi-worker deployment (uvicorn --workers >1 or gunicorn), staff-broadcast, typing and 'viewing' events won't reach clients connected to a different worker. Consider Redis pub/sub or single-worker deployment.
_create_cooldown is an in-memory dict without eviction — grows unbounded over time. Add a periodic prune or use a small LRU/TTL structure.

staff_list search branch: `q = {'$and': [q, {'$or': [...]}]} if q else {'$or': []}` — if the initial `q` is empty (which currently only happens if box is not one of the known values), it falls into `{'$or': []}` which Mongo treats as always-false. Not a live bug (box has defaults) but the fallback is confusing; use `q = {'$or': [...]}` when there's no scope filter.

post_message: internal check runs `_can_manage` first but for a non-internal message from a non-staff user, `_can_view` is validated only in the else branch — the current control flow is correct but reads as if staff bypass view checks entirely. Add explicit comment.

_pub_ticket ignores the `is_staff` parameter — every field (including fields dict which may hold personal data such as steam_id / reported_player) is sent to both regular users and staff. This is fine here because only the ticket owner or staff can call get_ticket, but the boolean param is misleading — either remove it or actually strip staff-only fields when False.

get_config: DEFAULT_CATEGORIES / DEFAULT_SERVERS objects are shared by reference across requests when no override exists in DB; admin_save + get_config paths are OK, but if any code mutates the returned dict it will pollute the defaults. Return copies (copy.deepcopy) to be safe.

WebSocket handler accepts the socket before checking the JWT. Anonymous (uid=None) sockets can still hold a connection and receive nothing but keep resources alive. Consider closing with 4401 if no valid token when the route is meant to be authenticated.
Frontend Support.jsx clicking 'Nuevo ticket' while a category is already selected keeps the previous category form (minor UX).
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo -> JWT; localStorage.primal_token; demo user role=admin (is_staff true).
